summary: The supplied encoder code shows incorrect bit shifts in the one-byte and two-byte Base64 tails, matching the encoding and round-trip failures for inputs whose lengths have remainders 1 or 2 modulo 3. The Base64.Padding failures are not explained by the supplied excerpts; the decoder implementation and its padding/error handling are needed before a concrete repair can account for every failure group.
hypotheses: The one-byte encoder tail shifts the remaining two bits by 3 instead of 4, and the two-byte tail shifts the remaining four bits by 1 instead of 2.
Base64UnescapeInternal has a separate defect in decoding padded one-byte inputs or handling their padding.
